What's new in 1.6.1
• Z80 and SNA snapshots load more reliably at high speeds. • Snapshot speed labels now reflect the selected sample rate. Choose 48 kHz (default) or 44.1 kHz in Settings. • A one-time warning reminds you to disconnect headphones before playback. Resetting Settings shows the warning and What's new again. • Read the changelog offline from the Home or player menu. • Android navigation buttons stay visible after theme changes and when returning to the app.
